# Dimensionless parameters

Source papers: `Bourgoin2002`, `Monchaux2009`.

## Definitions

| Symbol | Definition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Rm | K mu0 sigma 2 pi R_c^2 F | Monchaux2009 |
| Re | K 2 pi R_c^2 F / nu | Monchaux2009 |
| Theta | (F1 - F2)/(F1 + F2) | Monchaux2009 |
| gamma | (Gamma1 - Gamma2)/(Gamma1 + Gamma2) | Monchaux2009 |
| N | sigma B0^2 L / (rho U) | Bourgoin2002 |
| Pm | nu / eta = nu mu0 sigma | Bourgoin2002 |

## Typical ranges

| Symbol | Range | Unit | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rm | 0-52 | - | Ravelet2008 |
| Re | 0-5e6 | - | Monchaux2009 |
| T | 110-160 | deg C | Monchaux2009 |

definitions.definition: K mu0 sigma 2 pi R_c^2 F
definitions.notes: F = (F1 + F2)/2. K = 0.6 for exact counter-rotation.
Measures relative importance of global rotation to shear.
Used to identify one-cell/two-cell hydrodynamic transition.
Small in the reported induction experiments; N ~ 1e-5 in Bourgoin2002.

typical_ranges.notes: Laboratory range; high-Rm dynamo regime is far beyond current trust-LiMe validation.
Turbulent flow; velocity fluctuations are of order 40-50% of the mean.
